pages.name: welcome
pages.text_excerpt: Install TunaOS Welcome. This assistant will guide you through installing TunaOS onto this computer. You will choose a target disk and a few options. Nothing is written to any disk until you confirm on the last step. Get started

pages.name: disk
pages.text_excerpt: Select a disk Everything on the disk you pick will be erased. /dev/nvme0n1 476.9G · SAMSUNG MZVL2512HCJQ · nvme /dev/sda 1.8T · WDC WD20SPZX-22UA7 · sata Back Continue

pages.name: options
pages.text_excerpt: Options Sensible defaults are already chosen. Change them only if you need to. System Computer name tunaos Filesystem xfs Encryption Disk encryption No encryption Anyone with the disk can read your files. Back Continue

pages.name: confirm
pages.text_excerpt: Confirm The last screen before anything is written. Everything on the target disk will be erased. This cannot be undone. Summary Target disk /dev/nvme0n1 Filesystem xfs Encryption none Computer name tunaos Image ghcr.io/tuna-os/albacore:gno

pages.name: installing
pages.text_excerpt:
Installing TunaOS fisherman is writing the image to disk. [1/9] Partitioning /dev/nvme0n1

  created root partition (475.9 GiB)
[2/9] Formatting boot partitions
[3/9] Setting up encryption

pages.name: done
pages.text_excerpt: Installation complete Remove the installation media and restart the computer. Close

notes: Text comes from the strings the harness rendered each page from (the same constants the view reads), not from a widget tree or OCR, so this reports SCREEN PARITY only. It does not measure keyboard navigation, compositor rendering, or that the frontend launches under its real desktop — those stay the VM walkthrough's job.
